acceptance_checks: When a workspace search is opened, the user can filter and open matching notes, tasks and events through the existing guarded routes.
When the user selects note prose, Jin preserves the passage and can create a titled task with a persistent typed relationship to its source note.
When a user starts a prep note from an event, Jin opens the linked local note with an editable meeting outline and can navigate back to the correct event.
When an interrupted linked creation is retried with the same operation identity, the canonical files and index resolve to one object and its relationship.
When a task is scheduled, the user can choose its start and block duration through the task and Calendar entry points.
When controls are exercised on compact screens and with a keyboard, they remain reachable and preserve editor and navigation guards.
